description: Hybrid semantic + keyword search with budget-aware retrieval. Fast by default (~30ms cached, ~1s first query). Optional expand adds LLM query expansion (+1-2s) — only use for short/vague queries.

dry.description: Skip touch/reinforcement on results (for background queries)

expand.description: LLM query expansion (+1-2s). Use for short/vague queries like single words

namespace.description: Filter by namespace (also includes "default" namespace automatically)

since.description: Only memories created after this unix ms timestamp

source.description: Filter by source (e.g. session, extract, api)

tags.description: Filter by tags (must have ALL specified)

until.description: Only memories created before this unix ms timestamp

name: engram_recall
